reason: The Strassen proposals offer the clearest unmeasured route to reducing n=512 arithmetic, using the verified 256 helper, but copying, recombination, and FP32 error create substantial risk. The three Strassen workspace proposals overlap heavily; test one shared implementation and do not attribute its result to a single advisor. Fused transpose could remove packed-A scratch, but its repeated conversion work is unmeasured. Prior panel, schedule, and cache variants did not promote, which lowers their priority without proving these distinct variants will fail. Fallback and tail changes have limited impact on the fixed n=512 workload. The proposed SME2 post-index load form is unverified, and prior evidence says paired post-index loads cannot satisfy the required unequal strides.
